notes.title: UPDATE 0.1.1
notes.notes:
- Fixed the bug where when the player clicked "resume" in the pause menu the character would jump.
- Some parts of some stages have been modified for better player experience.
- The time between witch shots has been modified, making some stages less punitive.
- The character jumping bug that was occurring with some people has been fixed.

notes.title: Available Today!
notes.notes:
Hi Dear friends!
We are happy to announce that Pocket Witch is available TODAY!! Feel free to play and give us feedback about the game.

notes.title: Devlog - First trap to face on Pocket Witch
notes.notes:
Hello people!

The wooden spike is the main trap you will face on Pocket Witch. Present in most levels, the wooden thorn is one of the most dangerous traps that the little witch will face during her journey through the cursed dungeon.
Always remember!
The wooden spikes may seem not very dangerous but it will be the main cause of most of your deaths.

notes.title: Launching soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018438/85dcfece2d52f20ddec915632dbf4fb2a79bc880.gif[/img]

Hello, we are happy to announce that Pocket Witch will be released on October 25, 2022, alongside Steam's Halloween sale.
We believe the theme of this game is in line with this Steam promotions event and we will release it on the planned date and time.
We have prepared another very challenging and fun game, with improvements and several mechanics waiting for you.
Thanks to everyone who can add the game to their wishlist and we look forward to seeing you on launch day, so be prepared! ♥
